English Language.question: ১) <u>To err</u> is human. Here, “To err” is a/an-
English Language.exp: এখানে “To err” Infinitive হিসেবে কাজ করে।

English Language.question: ২) Heaven! It is an ecstatic moment of my life. Here, ‘Heaven’ is a/an-
English Language.exp: Interjection একটি part of speech যা আকস্মিক অনুভূতি যেমন আনন্দ, বিস্ময়, দুঃখ, প্রভৃতি বোঝাতে ব্যবহৃত হয়। যেমনঃ Wow! Hey! Hurray! Alas! Yippee!

English Language.question: ৩) We ________ to study for the test yet.
English Language.exp: Present perfect এ negative sentences এর ক্ষেত্রে yet ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং affirmative sentence ক্ষেত্রে already ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question: ৪) He drives _________ a tremendous speed.
English Language.exp: গাড়ি চলার গতির মাত্রা বুঝাতে Preposition at ব্যবহৃত হয়। যেমন- at low/high/full/top speed ।

English Language.question: ৫) The flight will take off _______ that the weather is good.
English Language.exp: শর্ত বুঝাতে Provided/Provided that(যদি) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question:
৬) Choose the best option to replace the underlined part of the sentence.
He started to study after dinner.
English Language.exp: কিছু verb আছে যাদের ক্ষেত্রে infinitive বা gerund যেকোন টা ব্যবহার করা যায়। যেমনঃ begin, hate, like, start, try ইত্যাদি।

English Language.question: ৭) Please, look above. Here ‘above’ is-
English Language.exp:
প্রদত্ত বাক্যে above শব্দটি look verb -কে modify করেছে। কোথায় /কোন দিকে তাকাবে? উপরে তাকাবে। তাই এখানে above হচ্ছে adverb of place . সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর adverb ।
উল্লেখ্য, above শব্দটি বাক্যে adverb, preposition এবং adjective হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হতে পারে। তবে প্রশ্নোক্ত বাক্যে, above শব্দটি preposition বা adjective হওয়ার কোন শর্তই পূরণ করতে পারছে না।
Source: Oxford Dictionary, Cambridge Dictionary

English Language.question: ৮) It is uncommon _______ such good crops in this section of the country.
English Language.exp: Adjective ‘Common/uncommon’ সবসময় infinitive অনুসরণ করে। যেমনঃ It is uncommon to find such good crops in this section of the country.

English Language.question: ৯) I don’t care him ______ he helps me or not.
English Language.exp: ইহা বা উহা নয় অর্থে Whether …… or not দুটি Clause কে যুক্ত করতে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question: ১০) I fell asleep ______ the film.
English Language.exp: During (preposition) যাবৎ/ব্যাপি/কোনো সময় ধরে। বাক্যটির অর্থ সিনেমা চলাকালীন সময়ে আমি ঘুমিয়ে পড়েছিলাম

English Language.question:
১১) Choose the best option to replace the underlined part of the sentence.
He talks as if he knew everything.
English Language.exp: যেন/যেমন অর্থে As if/as though  দুটি clause কে যুক্ত করতে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question: ১২) He ____ to playground yesterday.
English Language.exp: ‘Yesterday’ is a modifier which helps us to know that the work has happened in the past. So the tense will be simple past. Hence ‘walked’ is the correct answer.

English Language.question: ১৩) The organization was in need of volunteers.. Here 'was in need of' can be transformed into ____.
English Language.exp:
Sub + be + in need of + noun
Jill is in need of money. (Jill needs money.)
The roof is in need of repair. (The roof needs to be repaired.)
The organization was in need of volunteers. (The organization needed volunteers.)
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 91

English Language.question: ১৪) None <u>but</u> the brave deserve the fair. The underlined word is a/an-
English Language.exp:
But can be used in the following ways:
As a conjunction (connecting two phrases or clauses):
She’s 83 but she still goes swimming every day.
As a way of starting a new sentence and connecting it to the previous sentence:
It was in Cairo that he met Nadia. But that’s another story.
As a preposition (followed by a noun):
None but the brave deserve the fair.
There’s been nothing but trouble since he came.
As an adverb:
We can but hope that things will improve.
Source: Macmillan Dictionary

English Language.question: ১৫) Bangladesh should never yield _______ foreign pressure.
English Language.exp: Yield to somebody/something- নতি স্বীকার করা।

English Language.question: ১৬) John _______ the material.
English Language.exp:
Sub+has/have + yet + verb infinitive
We have yet to decide what to do with the money.
John has yet to learn the material.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 63

English Language.question: ১৭) Fire burns. What kind of verb ‘burn’ is?
English Language.exp: Intransitive verb এর কোন object প্রয়োজন হয় না। তারা নিজে নিজেই বাক্য সম্পূর্ণ করতে পারে।

English Language.question: ১৮) This is mine. Here ''mine'' is-
English Language.exp:
Mine, ours, hers, theirs is some examples of possessive pronouns.
Source: Cliff’s Toefl

English Language.question: ১৯) Being cordial _______ one of his greatest assets.
English Language.exp:
If a sentence begins with [verb + ing] (gerund), the verb must also be singular.
Being cordial is one of his greatest assets.
Dieting is very popular today.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 74

English Language.question: ২০) _______ eggs were served to the players.
English Language.exp: এখানে Participle হিসেবে Boiled বসবে। উল্লেখ্য, Participle একই সাথে Verb এবং Adjective উভয়ের কাজ করে।

English Language.question: ২১) I count ______ your help.
English Language.exp: Count on/upon- কোন কিছুর উপর নির্ভর করা।

English Language.question: ২২) The girl <u>dancing</u> is my cousin. The underlined word is a/an-
English Language.exp: Dancing শব্দটি the girl শব্দকে modify করে, তাই এটি একটি participle । উল্লেখ্য, Participle একই সাথে Verb এবং Adjective উভয়ের কাজ করে।

English Language.question: ২৩) Hand me that book. Here ‘that’ is-
English Language.exp: Demonstrative pronouns normally indicate the closeness of or distance from the speaker, either literally or symbolically. This, these, that, and those are the demonstrative pronouns.

English Language.question: ২৪) I have no aptitude _______ music.
English Language.exp: Aptitude for something-  কোন কিছুর জন্য ঝোঁক, আগ্রহ।

English Language.question: ২৫) I took a map with me, as I didn’t want to ____ my way on the journey.
English Language.exp: কিছু Verb এর পর to+verb (present form) হয়। এমন কিছু verb- want, wish, seem, start, prefer, offer, love, learn, continue, hope, dare.

English Language.question:
২৬) Find out the missing word from the following sentence.
The chief guest of the seminar spoke to the audience concerning career.
English Language.exp:
Concerning (Preposition):
Meaning: On the subject of or in connection with; about.
বাংলা অর্থ - বিষয়ে বা সমন্ধে

The chief guest of the seminar spoke to the audience concerning (জড়িত অর্থে) career.
তাই their সঠিক উত্তর।

English Language.question: ২৭) Which one of the following is collective noun?
English Language.exp: Collective noun: a count noun that denotes a group of individuals (e.g. class, assembly, family, crew, cattle).

English Language.question: ২৮) He succeeded ______ passing the examination.
English Language.exp: Succeed in doing something- কোন কিছু করতে সমর্থ বা সফল হওয়া।

English Language.question: ২৯) The ship struck an iceberg, which tore a huge hole in _____ side.
English Language.exp:
Ships and sometimes cars & other vehicles when regarded with affection or respect are considered feminine.
The ship struck an iceberg, which tore a huge hole in her side.
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৩০) Mr. Yohan Shunko died _________ malaria.
English Language.exp: Died of - রোগের কারণে মারা যাওয়া।

English Language.question: ৩১) Which one is the male form of ‘ewe’?
English Language.exp:
The male form of ewe (ভেড়ী) is ram (ভেড়া).
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৩২) He fantasized _______ winning the lottery.
English Language.exp: Fantasized about- কল্পনা করা (কোন ঘটনা/ বস্তু সম্পর্কে)।

English Language.question: ৩৩) Her success was shattered by her later commentary. Here, ‘Commentary’ is a/an-
English Language.exp: Suffix ‘ry’  যুক্ত কিছু শব্দ যেমন commentary, Necessary, etc. Noun হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question:
৩৪) Find out the missing word.
My children are great help to me.
English Language.exp:
Some abstract nouns can be used in a particular sense with a/an:

a help:
My children are a great help to me.
A good map would be a help.

a relief:
It was a relief to sit down.
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৩৫) The government gave _____ the demands of the people.
English Language.exp: Give in- সমর্থন দেওয়া এবং যার প্রতি সমর্থন দেওয়া হয়, তার পূর্বে to বসে।

English Language.question: ৩৬) Which gender is the word ‘parent’?
English Language.exp: কিছু Noun আছে যা Male ও Female উভয়কেই বুঝায় তাদেরকে Common gender বলে। যেমন- Baby, Child, Parent, Person, Sibling etc.

English Language.question:
৩৭) Find out the missing word from the following sentence.
The salary of a professor is higher than ______ a secretary.
English Language.exp: কোন sentence এ একই ধরনের Noun এর মধ্যে তুলনা করার সময় পূর্বের Noun এর পুনরাবৃত্তি পরিহার করতে singular noun এর পরিবর্তে that of এবং plural noun এর পরিবর্তে those of ব্যবহৃত হয়। যেমনঃ Your advice is no different from that of the other friends. The salary of a professor is higher than that of a secretary. Source: Cliffs TOEFL

English Language.question: ৩৮) Running is bad _______ you.
English Language.exp:
He is bad/good at cricket. [a bad/good player]
Running is bad/good for you. [unhealthy/healthy]
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৩৯) Neither of the students is true. Here, ‘Neither’ is a/an-
English Language.exp: Distributive pronoun: এই Pronoun একজাতীয় একাধিক ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর মধ্যে প্রত্যেকটিকে পৃথকভাবে বুঝায়। যেমনঃ  each, either, neither, etc.

English Language.question: ৪০) It was <u>she not me,</u> who put forth the attractive proposition.
English Language.exp: কোন pronoun যখন ‘to be’ Verb এর Complement হিসেবে বসে তখন তার Subjective form ব্যবহৃত হয়। যেমনঃ It was I who first raised the issue in the meeting. It was she, not I who put forth the attractive proposition.

English Language.question: ৪১) He knows more than I ______ at his age.
English Language.exp:
When the same verb is required before & after than/as we can use an auxiliary for the second verb:
I earn less than he does. (less than ge does)
The same tense need not be used in both clauses:
He knows more than I did at his age.
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৪২) The function of an adjective is to modify a-
English Language.option4: ঘ) noun or anything equivalent to a noun
English Language.exp: The function of an adjective is to modify a noun, pronoun or anything equivalent to a noun.

English Language.question:
৪৩) Find the incorrect part of the following sentence.
He gave reluctantly her the money.
English Language.exp:
Adverbs of manner come after the verb:
She danced beautifully.
or after the object when there is one:
He gave her the money reluctantly.
They speak English well.
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৪৪) ‘Please, come again’ here ‘please’ is-
English Language.exp: এখানে ‘Please’ শব্দটি verb ‘come’ কে modify করেছে, তাই এটি Adverb .

English Language.question: ৪৫) Which of the following sentence sounds negative?
English Language.option1: ক) I have hardly any spare time.
English Language.option2: খ) Someone’s passport has been stolen.
English Language.option4: ঘ) All of them sounds positive
English Language.exp:
Some words like Hardly, barely, scarcely are sound negative.
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৪৬) Which one of the following is demonstrative adjective?
English Language.exp:
Demonstrative adjective: this, that, these, those.
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৪৭) Everyday I buy huge _________ .
English Language.exp: Tomato শব্দের Plural ‘Tomatoes’

English Language.question: ৪৮) Why did George ______ so early?
English Language.exp: Wh question word + auxiliary verb/ do/does/did + subject + main verb + complement.

English Language.question: ৪৯) The scene was horrifying. Here, ‘horrifying’ is a/an-
English Language.exp:
Participle used as adjectives.
Present participle adjectives amusing, boring, tiring etc., are active and mean ‘having this effect’. Past participle adjectives amused, horrified, tired etc,. are passive and ‘affected in this way’.
The scene was horrifying. (The spectators were horrified.)
Source: A practical English Grammar, Oxford University Press.

English Language.question: ৫০) Walking in the morning is good for health. Here, ‘Walking’ is/an-
English Language.exp: এখানে “Walking” Gerund হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে। উল্লেখ্য, Gerund একই সাথে verb ও noun এর কাজ করে।
